ClaimBoundary.EvidenceRule: This report is semisynthetic stress evidence for measurement-operator precision and robustness.
ClaimBoundary.FieldSignoffRule: It is not real production-site validation or sign-off.
ClaimBoundary.BoundarySampleRule: Stress samples cover blur, noise, low contrast, occlusion, polarity flip, subpixel offset, outlier contour, and weak edge cases.
